**Assignment for MERN Stack Developer**

**Required Stack:**

* **Frontend**: React

* **Backend**: Express.js

* **Database**: MongoDB

* **State Management**: Any external library (Redux, Zustand, Recoil, etc.)  
  **Timezone Management**: Preferably dayjs or any suitable library

**Assignment Walkthrough (Recording Link)** :   [https://www.loom.com/share/5528d6e35a184007a37e222949400279?sid=29d37e93-3098-4bc6-bfe1-429f5c9d25ab](https://www.loom.com/share/5528d6e35a184007a37e222949400279?sid=29d37e93-3098-4bc6-bfe1-429f5c9d25ab)

**Project Overview**

Build an **Event Management System** where an admin can create multiple profiles and manage events across multiple users and timezones. where users can view, update, and create events, respecting their selected timezone.

**Functional Requirements**

**Profiles**

* Admin can create multiple user profiles by entering a name.

* No functionality is required for deleting profiles.

** Event Creation**

* Admin (or any user) can create events for one or multiple profiles at the same time.

* Event fields:

* Profiles: Select one or more users.  
* Timezone: Pick a timezone for the event.  
* Start Date \+ Time: Calendar \+ time selector.  
* End Date \+ Time: Calendar \+ time selector.

**Rules:**

* End date/time cannot be in the past relative to the selected start date/time.

* Start and end times should respect the selected timezone of the user(s).

**Event Viewing & Updating**

* Users can view all events assigned to them.

* Users can update all events assigned to them.

* Each event stores:

  * createdAt (timestamp in user timezone)  
  * updatedAt (timestamp in user timezone)

**Multi-timezone handling:**

* Each user can pick their own timezone.

* All events must display according to the user’s selected timezone.

* Updating events should reflect properly across all users’ selected timezones.


**Bonus / Extra Credit**

**Event Update Logs:**

* Whenever an event is updated, log the change.

* Show previous vs. updated values and the timestamp of the update in the user’s selected timezone.

* If a user changes their timezone, all timestamps and logs should automatically convert to the new timezone.
